commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Here is a change. Maroan Sannadi is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
90+4' The referee signals a substitution. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) is brought on as a substitute for Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
90+4' The game is interrupted. Ander Guevara (Alaves) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+1' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
87' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Carles Alena and he is replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
87' Substitution. Jon Guridi makes way for Pau Cabanes (Alaves).
84' Looks like Moussa Diarra (Alaves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
81' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
77' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Carlos Martin (Alaves) replaces Antonio Blanco.
76' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) launches a cross from the corner, but Antonio Sivera is alert to thwart the effort.
76' The ball is cleared after Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
75' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
72' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) replacing Manu Sanchez.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Toni Martinez as he is replaced by Asier Villalibre (Alaves).
71' 1 - 0 This is definitely not what Manu Sanchez (Alaves) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:0.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Peio Canales walks off the pitch to be replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
65' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the left post.
65' Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao) will take the corner.
63' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
63' A cross into the box from Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
56' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
55' We are about to witness a subsitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) for Aingeru Olabarrieta.
55' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Djalo will be replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
53' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Toni Martinez (Alaves), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
52' What a chance! Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) outjumps the defence to connect with the resulting set piece and attempts to head home, but his effort only rattles the left post.
52' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
49' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Jose Munuera blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies well over the crossbar.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
40' Ath Bilbao work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
37' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
31' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
25' The corner from Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by the defence.
24' A long ball forward to Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
21' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Jose Munuera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' Aingeru Olabarrieta (Ath Bilbao) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
15' Aingeru Olabarrieta (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
11' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
11' Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
11' Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
9' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
6' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
5' Toni Martinez (Alaves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
2' Ander Guevara (Alaves) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Unai Simon pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
2' Toni Martinez (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Jose Munuera was nominated as the referee for this game.
